title: Checkpoint: Append-Only Packet
prompt:
In your editor: `struct frame { unsigned char tag; unsigned short seq; unsigned int payload; };`. Implement:
1. `void frame_report(size_t *off_seq, size_t *off_payload, size_t *size)` — offsetof/sizeof measured, not hardcoded.
2. Define `struct frame_v2 { unsigned char tag; unsigned short seq; unsigned int payload; unsigned long long ts; };` and `int frame_prefix_stable(void)` — 1 iff tag/seq/payload offsets are identical between the versions (offsetof-verified).
3. `unsigned long long sum_upto(int n, ...)` — totals n unsigned ints passed variadic.

tests.name: measured layout
tests.hint: tag at 0; seq at 2 (2-aligned); payload at 4; size rounds to the 4-alignment.

tests.name: prefix survives the bump
tests.hint: Appending ts after payload cannot move the earlier members — verified, not assumed.

tests.name: variadic totals
tests.hint: va_arg(unsigned int) walks the argument window; 7+8+9 = 24.
